name: primitives-effects-theme-toggler

frames.best_why: The control is settled with Dark clearly selected and no cursor overlapping a label.

tagline: Three-way Light, Dark and System switch with a page-wide wipe.
summary: A small settings card with a segmented control for Light, Dark and System; picking one flips the whole page's theme with a gradual sweep instead of an instant snap.
appearance: A dark rounded card titled Appearance with two lines of grey copy above a three-part control. Each third holds a small icon and a label; the active one gets a lighter background, white text and a soft shadow.
behaviour: Clicking a segment marks it active and reveals the new theme across the page with a wipe that grows from one edge. Light and Dark resolve directly, while System follows the operating system setting.
demo_content: Heading Appearance, a line about the view transition wipe, and options Light, Dark and System.
search_phrases: toggle between day and night mode
theme picker with sun moon icons
site setting to follow the system
use_when: A site offers light, dark and system themes and wants the switch to feel deliberate.
avoid_when: The wipe needs the browser's View Transitions API, so older browsers just snap with no sweep.
customise: It renders whatever the children function returns and calls your setTheme, with theme, resolved theme and wipe direction as props; the wipe timing is fixed.
weight_why: One view transition and an empty style tag; no loop or canvas.

a11y.note: The chosen option is marked only by a data attribute, so screen readers are not told which theme is active, and there is no focus ring.

issues: The active segment is shown only by colour and shadow, with no tick or check.
The wipe itself is hard to see in these frames; most look like a plain theme swap.
polish_why: Neat card and tidy segmented control, but it is a standard-looking theme picker.
